name: Nelnet Renewable Energy

about:
Nelnet Renewable Energy is based in Lincoln, Nebraska. The company has been acquired by MARS Energy Group, a national provider of commercial and utility-scale solar solutions, engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, and long-term energy infrastructure. The acquisition is intended to expand services, reach, and support for customers through enhanced national coverage and deeper technical and financial capabilities.

Nelnet continues to support a set of legacy offerings for existing customers while directing new commercial and industrial (C&I) and EPC solution customers to MARS Energy Group. The company manages over $313 million in tax equity under management alongside co-investment partners and operates an experienced venture capital investment team focused on CleanTech and ClimateTech innovation. It also coordinates workmanship warranty support through state-specific partners in Colorado, Indiana, Iowa, and Nebraska.

The firm serves commercial and industrial solar customers, residential solar customers in Illinois, Missouri, and Wisconsin, and tax equity and co-investing clients seeking sustainability and investment opportunities. Its venture capital arm targets strategic CleanTech and ClimateTech solutions.

Nelnet differentiates itself through its advanced technical and financial capabilities, commitment to reliability and transparency, and a unified team dedicated to long-term performance. The tax equity platform and venture capital expertise provide a unique combination of project finance and innovation funding.
